name: Climb For Animals Eggs🥚
desc:
Welcome to Climb For Animals Eggs 🧗🥚

Climb higher, reach new biomes, and hatch Eggs to discover amazing Animals! 🐾✨

How to play:
🧗 Climb to reach new areas
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥚 Find and hatch Eggs to discover Animals
🐶 Place your Animals at your base to earn Cash
💵 Upgrade your income and your upgrades
🏗️ Expand your base to hold even more Animals  

💤 Your Animals keep earning Cash while you’re offline!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your earnings and climb even farther!

👍 Like the game and join the group to get +10K Speed!
